runtime.groups: ordered command groups with IDs and labels
runtime.overflow: responsive More menu; important commands stay visible
runtime.compact: Ordinary inline Buttons with no extra frame; measures allocated container width for overflow. Same command events, disabled state, focus transfer, and priority rules.

tableCompositions: Compact appearance is represented inside the two published Table action compositions recorded in design/table-variants.json, using linked Buttons and Dropdown. The standalone family has no published ID.
